title: Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Modularity for General Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning, the ability to learn from sequential experience while retaining and adapting prior knowledge, is central to intelligent systems operating in changing environments. However, conventional continual learning is typically studied with offline task-wise training and clear task boundaries, leaving a substantial gap from general continual learning under online, uncertain, and evolving data streams. In this regime, intelligent systems must separate conflicting experience to reduce interference while integrating compatible experience to promote generalization. Inspired by the organization of the Drosophila learning and memory system, we identify a hierarchical modular principle that coordinates both functions through expert specialization and ensemble integration. translated_title: 面向通用持续学习的脑启发分层模块化方法
translated_abstract: 持续学习，即在顺序经验中学习的同时保留并调整既有知识的能力，是智能系统在不断变化环境中运行的核心。然而，传统持续学习研究通常基于离线的按任务训练和明确的任务边界，这与在线、不确定且不断演化的数据流下的通用持续学习之间存在巨大差距。在这种情境下，智能系统必须分离相互冲突的经验以减少干扰，同时整合兼容的经验以促进泛化。受果蝇学习与记忆系统组织结构的启发，我们识别出一种分层模块化原则，通过专家特化与集成协调来实现这两种功能。我们将该原则实例化为对预训练基础模型的轻量级模块化适配，结合脑启发的随机扩展用于专家路由以及多样化……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 受果蝇学习记忆系统分层模块化组织启发，本文提出通过专家特化与集成协调，对预训练基础模型进行轻量级脑启发模块化适配，以实现能在冲突经验分离与兼容经验整合之间取得平衡的通用持续学习。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the hierarchical modular organization of the Drosophila learning and memory system, this paper proposes lightweight brain-inspired modular adaptation of pretrained foundation models that coordinates expert specialization and ensemble integration to achieve general continual learning by separating conflicting experience while integrating compatible experience.
